entities.name: Caer Ulios
entities.description: Central safehold of the Wilt-Leaf elves on Shadowmoor, product of the Great Aurora transformation of Lys Alana; seat of the Wilt-Leaf king and queen.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: Gilt-Leaf capital transformed by the Great Aurora into Caer Ulios.

entities.name: Wilt-Leaf elves
entities.description: Elves of Shadowmoor whose safehold was Caer Ulios.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: Transformation that turned Lys Alana into Caer Ulios.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Faerie queen who killed the denizens of Caer Ulios with thornvines to feed on their life force.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Led rebels who fought Oona's loyalists at Caer Ulios.

entities.name: Gryffid
entities.description: Wilt-Leaf First Vigilant who sacrificed himself to sever Oona's connection to the King and Queen.

entities.name: Wilt-Leaf King and Queen
entities.description: Rulers who unwillingly served as a conduit for elven life energy.

entities.name: Kinscaer
entities.description: Another place where Oona contracted elves' help and killed denizens.

events.summary: Oona contracts the elves' help and kills all the denizens of Caer Ulios with thornvines to feed on their magic and life force.
events.quote: killed all of the denizens by her thornvines

events.summary: Maralen's rebels and Oona's loyalists clash in the last great battle of fae at Caer Ulios.
events.quote: Caer Ulios was the place of the last great battle of fae

events.summary: Gryffid sacrifices himself to sever the connection between Oona and the King and Queen, weakening her.
events.quote: sacrificed himself to sever the connection between Oona and the King and Queen

events.summary: Caer Ulios is later repopulated by Wilt-Leaf survivors.
events.quote: Caer Ulios was later repopulated by Wilt-Leaf survivors

relations.note: Their conflict centered on Caer Ulios.
relations.quote: the final moments of the war
